amanda: quick sync — we need a compact compatibility matrix for routing fallbacks by tier+region. found a few real gaps when we simulated traffic to cheaper variants.
raj: can you list the main gaps?
sasha: tokenizer differences (subword vs byte-level) + shorter max_context on some q4 variants. tool-calling is spotty too — some variants don't emit structured tool payloads.
ian: do we have concrete cases where fallback changed app behavior?
amanda: yup. e.g. enterprise job-runner -> fallback to rw-7b-q4 in eu-west. tokenizer split changed token indices for tool calls, tool-call parser failed.
marta: ugh. so not just perf/cost, it's correctness.
kevin: what's the proposed granularity of matrix? model_variant x capability flags?
sasha: I propose columns: model_variant, tokenizer_profile, max_context, tool_calling_supported, kv_cache_compat, known_tokenization_breaks
amanda: example snippet I shared in local doc, pasting small sample here:
```
model_variant,tokenizer,max_context,tool_calls,kv_compat,notes
rw-70b,byte-level,8192,yes,full,ok in all regions
rw-7b-q4,subword,2048,no,partial,breaks on multi-token tool args
rw-13b-tilt,byte-level,4096,yes,partial,requires prompt-normalization
```
raj: perfect. can we add a routing policy column: preferred_fallback_for_tier (gold/silver/enterprise)?
sasha: yes — plus region constraints. some variants not available in ap-south.
ian: we should also capture telemetry signals to detect subtle regressions after routing change: tool_call_fail_rate, avg_latency, token_delta_distribution.
marta: for console UX: make matrix filterable by tier and region, and show quick toggle to opt-out of toolcall-fallbacks. customers should be able to say "never fallback to variants that lack tool-calls".
kevin: rollout policy idea: canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% with automatic rollback if tool_call_fail_rate increases > 0.5% absolute or latency > 2x baseline for 10m.
amanda: agreed. add metric: downstream-errors-from-tool-call-parser. that's most sensitive.
sasha: edge case: tokenizer parity can be mitigated by prompt-normalization layer, but that's brittle. better to avoid fallbacks that change tokenization for any requests that rely on tool offsets.
ian: how do we detect those requests? heuristics: presence of tool call placeholders, or explicit tool_calling flag on route. also track delta in token counts pre/post fallback.
kevin: infra side: router can check compatibility table at decision time. if mismatch found and request marked tool-sensitive, skip that variant. cheap and simple.
marta: UX should expose a per-route "fallback_sensitivity" setting: conservative|balanced|aggressive. conservative = avoid any variant with tool/token mismatches.
raj: quota impact? if conservative blocks too many fallbacks, route may hit quota limits and cause 429s. need circuit-breaker: if primary pool overloaded and conservative blocks, optionally expand to region-compatible variants or surface quota exhaustion in console.
amanda: propose default mapping by tier: enterprise -> conservative, gold -> balanced, silver -> aggressive. can be overridden per-route.
sasha: action items: 1) eng-platform: publish initial compatibility CSV and service to serve it (kevin) 2) eng-runtime: implement router check + canary rollout hooks (ian) 3) console: matrix UI + per-route fallback_sensitivity (marta) 4) telemetry: add tool_call_fail_rate + token_delta hist (raj)
kevin: I'll sketch svc interface: `/compat/v1?variant=rw-7b-q4` returns flags. simple JSON schema. router caches for 60s.
ian: deploy-bot: canary policy template created by ops.
deploy-bot: deploy-candidate: fallback-router-checker:v1 -> canary started (1%)
marta: small UX note — show a warning badge on routes that have mismatches and an inline "why this matters" explainer. reduces support tickets.
raj: final thought: add an automated nightly job that runs a few synthetic tool-calling prompts across all variant pairs to detect regressions early.
amanda: agreed. i'll own the nightly runner spec.
sasha: :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll put a draft API and sample CSV in the eng-platform backlog ticket.
amanda: thanks all. we'll align on the ticket and schedule a 30m sync after the draft so we can finalize thresholds.
kevin: ping me on thread when draft is up @kevin
amanda: noted. thanks everyone :rocket:
